lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular spots arranged in semi-regular vertical columns posterior to the fifth gill slit. The spots exhibit a size gradient, decreasing in diameter from the mid-lateral line toward the dorsal ridge.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible in the mid-flank region, intersecting with vertical columns of spots to create a grid-like structural appearance.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a highlight on the superior edge and a shadow on the inferior edge, extending from the branchial region towards the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense, randomized distribution of small-diameter high-luminance spots on the dorsal surface of the head. A smaller teleost fish is visible positioned ventrally to the primary pectoral fin.
